entity.description: A site's Smithy settings: one row for a site that mounts Smithy, read with the defaults when there is none.

field.name: homeGroupId
field.description: The group whose Overview is the app's home; empty: Explore

field.name: groupCreateEnumId
field.description: SmithyCreatePolicy; ScpRequest when empty

field.name: repositoryCreateEnumId
field.description: Personal repositories; ScpVerified when empty

field.name: forkCreateEnumId
field.description: ScpVerified when empty

field.name: accountContactListId
field.description: The scope category of personal namespaces' conversations

field.name: defaultMaxRepositories
field.description: An account's; 5 when empty

field.name: defaultRepositoryBytes
field.description: An account's, for one repository; 1073741824 when empty

field.name: defaultLfsBytes
field.description: An account's; 1073741824 when empty

field.name: defaultRunnerMinutes
field.description: An account's, a month; 0 when empty

field.name: groupRepositoryBytes
field.description: A group's default, for one repository; 5368709120 when empty

field.name: groupLfsBytes
field.description: A group's default; 5368709120 when empty

field.name: groupRunnerMinutes
field.description: A group's default, a month; 2000 when empty

field.name: maxEditBytes
field.description: The page editor's limit; 1048576 when empty

field.name: repositoryKind
field.description: The kind of a new repository, a GitRepository.repositoryKind: db when empty, or local

field.name: outsideRunApproval
field.description: When an outside pipeline run (untrusted: a fork's or a pushed-for-review merge request, an account below Developer) waits for a Maintainer's approval: first (the default: each new head waits until its author and pusher have had a merge request merged in the repository by another account), always, or never (only a top-level group's Owner sets never for a group). A group may set its own

field.name: outsideRunMaxJobs
field.description: The most jobs an outside run may have; 10 when empty

entity.description: A group of repositories and subgroups, to four levels. A subgroup inherits the settings fields it leaves empty from the nearest group above.

field.name: parentGroupId
field.description: Empty for a top-level group

field.name: groupPath
field.description: The full path, lower case (moqui, moqui/addons); unique in a site

field.name: description
field.description: Plain text

field.name: avatarId
field.description: As PublicSiteProfile.avatarId

field.name: visibilityEnumId
field.description: SmithyVisibility; a subgroup is no wider than its parent, and the evaluator takes the narrowest

field.name: statusId
field.description: SmgRequested, SmgActive, SmgRefused; only an active group is found by anyone but its requester and the operators

field.name: contactListId
field.description: The group's forum category; set when the group becomes active

field.name: newsContactListId
field.description: The announcements category

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: One project for all of the group's repositories, optional

field.name: issueRepositoryId
field.description: The group's tracker

field.name: agreementEnumId
field.description: SmithyAgreement; SmaInherit when empty

field.name: agreementPath
field.description: AUTHORS.md when empty

field.name: runnerPoolId
field.description: The GitRunnerPool of trusted runs, one an operator allowed (a shared pool or one of the top-level group's); empty: the nearest group above that sets it, else the engine's choice

field.name: outsideRunnerPoolId
field.description: The pool of untrusted runs, as runnerPoolId

field.name: outsideRunApproval
field.description: first, always or never (SmithySite.outsideRunApproval); empty: the nearest group above that sets it, else the site's

field.name: maxRepositoryBytes
field.description: Empty: the site's default

field.name: maxLfsBytes
field.description: Empty: the site's default

field.name: runnerMinutesMonthly
field.description: A top-level group's, for every repository below it (the pipeline runs' owner); empty: the site's default

field.name: hiddenAt
field.description: Set: Not Found to everyone but its Owners and the site's staff

entity.description: A party's role on a group: one row for a party and a group. A change of role updates it, and the audit log keeps the history.

field.name: roleEnumId
field.description: SmithyRole; held on the group, its subgroups and their repositories

field.name: thruDate
field.description: An end date; empty: none

entity.description: What Smithy keeps of a hosted repository: its group or personal namespace, its slug and path, its visibility and what it has turned on. Its description, default branch, archive date and size are the GitRepository's and are not copied; the fork parent is GitRepository.forkOfRepositoryId.

field.name: repositoryId
field.description: The moqui.resource.GitRepository

field.name: groupId
field.description: Exactly one of groupId and ownerPartyId is set

field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: A personal namespace: the party whose handle is the first path segment

field.name: repositoryPath
field.description: Equal to GitRepository.repositoryPath; written only by SmithyCore.setPath, which writes both

field.name: name
field.description: As typed

field.name: visibilityEnumId
field.description: SmithyVisibility; no wider than its group, and the evaluator takes the narrowest

field.name: issuesEnabled
field.description: N when empty

field.name: mergeRequestsEnabled
field.description: Y when empty

field.name: pipelinesEnabled
field.description: N when empty

field.name: forumEnabled
field.description: N when empty

field.name: docsEnabled
field.description: N when empty

field.name: docsPath
field.description: docs when empty

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The project of its issues

field.name: confidentialWorkEffortId
field.description: The companion project of its confidential issues' tasks, made on first need: restricted, never linked to the repository (no WorkEffortGitRepository), and with exactly the internal accounts that are Smithy Owners of the repository or its groups as its managers. So Projects' own rule, a task is seen by those on its project, keeps a confidential issue's task from everyone else.

field.name: contactListId
field.description: Its forum subcategory, when it has one

field.name: nextIssueNumber
field.description: Starts at 1

field.name: agreementEnumId
field.description: SmithyAgreement; SmaInherit when empty

field.name: agreementPath
field.description: Empty: inherited

field.name: importedHistory
field.description: Y: the repository's history was imported (DG8 sets it). Only then does the agreement check take a commit that no push or write of an account brought (it came by the import) as its author's own, by the author's confirmed address or linked GitHub login

field.name: pinnedSequence
field.description: Pinned on its group's Overview when set

field.name: componentName
field.description: From component.xml

field.name: componentDependsOn
field.description: Names, comma separated

field.name: componentCommitId
field.description: The commit it was read at

field.name: hiddenAt
field.description: Set: Not Found to everyone but its Owners and the site's staff

entity.description: A party's role on one repository, beside what its groups give.

field.name: roleEnumId
field.description: SmithyRole

entity.description: An issue: a task of the repository's (or its group's) project with a number in the repository, its confidential mark and its conversation, a ForumTopic of kind record. The number comes from SmithyRepository.nextIssueNumber under a lock of that row. Its title is the task's name and the topic's title; its text is the topic's first post, of which the task's description is a plain-text copy.

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The task

field.name: rootCommEventId
field.description: The record topic

field.name: confidential
field.description: Y: read and edited by the Owners of the repository and its groups and by operators; its reporter keeps their own text and the replies addressed to them

entity.description: A label made in a repository's tracker (storeLabel): the WorkEffortCategory of type WcatLabel is this repository's alone, though its project may be shared by the group's other repositories. It is listed, changed and deleted through this repository only. An organization's label (no row here) is shared and is changed in Projects.

field.name: description
field.description: Plain text; the label's name is the category's description

entity.description: A milestone made in a repository's tracker (storeMilestone): the WetMilestone of the project is this repository's alone, listed, changed and set on issues through this repository only.

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The milestone

entity.description: What Smithy keeps beside a merge request of the git host (moqui.resource.GitMergeRequest, which has its number, branches, reviewers and merge): the site, the conversation (a ForumTopic of kind record whose first post is the merge request's text; GitMergeRequest.description is a plain-text copy) and the result of the contributor agreement check for its head. While the first post is held, GitMergeRequest.hiddenDate is set (design-smithy §9.1, §9.3, §9.4).

field.name: mergeRequestId
field.description: The moqui.resource.GitMergeRequest

field.name: repositoryId
field.description: The target

field.name: rootCommEventId
field.description: The record topic

field.name: agreementStateEnumId
field.description: SmithyAgreementState

field.name: agreementDetail
field.description: JSON: who is missing what

field.name: agreementCommitId
field.description: The head it was computed for; while it is not the merge request's head the result is not that head's, and reads as unsigned

field.name: agreementCheckedAt
field.description: When recheckAgreement last ran: once a minute

field.name: botOperatorPartyId
field.description: The operator who declared

field.name: botConfirmedByPartyId
field.description: The Maintainer who confirmed

field.name: runApprovedByPartyId
field.description: "Approve and run" (DG5)

entity.description: A cache of the contributor agreement check (design-smithy §9.4, step 3): a signature line of a list of the agreement file at a branch, with the commit that added it and that commit's author when it is an account. Rebuilt from the file when its blob at the branch is another.

field.name: refName
field.description: The branch

field.name: listEnumId
field.description: SmithyAgreementList

field.name: login
field.description: Lower case

field.name: commitId
field.description: The commit that added the line; empty when none was found

field.name: authorPartyId
field.description: That commit's author, when an account

field.name: authorEmail
field.description: The address that commit's author gave, lower case: the row counts only while it is still a confirmed address of authorPartyId

field.name: unverified
field.description: Y: the history read was cut at its bound before the commit that added the line was found, so whose it is cannot be said

field.name: blobId
field.description: The file's blob the row was read from

entity.description: A GitHub id an account's sign-in proved (DG8 review): written when the framework tells of a sign-in that linked it (UserAccount.externalUserId; the sso-linked-service, SmithyImportServices.handle#SsoLinked) and the flow's endpoints are exactly GitHub's own, so a claim made later, when a membership becomes active, claims only for an id proven so and still the account's.

field.name: githubHost
field.description: github.com or an Enterprise Server's host

entity.description: An account's Smithy settings in a site, made when first needed: its limits (each the site's default when empty), the bot mark and the GitHub login.

field.name: githubLogin
field.description: Lower case; set at a sign-in through the GitHub provider, or by the import for a placeholder

field.name: githubUserId
field.description: GitHub's own id of the user (a login can be renamed, the id not): set by the import for a placeholder, and moved to the account that claims it, whose sign-in through a GitHub provider names the same id (UserAccount.externalUserId)

field.name: githubHost
field.description: The GitHub githubUserId and githubLogin are of: github.com (also when empty), or a GitHub Enterprise Server's host, whose login is kept as login@host so it is apart from github.com's. The import sets it from the API it reads (mantle@smithy-github-api); a claim needs a GitHub sign-in of the same host

field.name: placeholder
field.description: Y: made by the import, not yet claimed

field.name: maxRepositories
field.description: Personal repositories; empty: the site's default

field.name: maxRepositoryBytes
field.description: For one repository; empty: the site's default

field.name: maxLfsBytes
field.description: Empty: the site's default

field.name: runnerMinutesMonthly
field.description: Empty: the site's default

field.name: setByPartyId
field.description: Who last set a limit or the bot mark

entity.description: The old path of a renamed group, or the old handle of an account: pages redirect from it to where the group or the namespace is now, until the path is taken. Another party may take it 90 days after createdAt, the party it belongs to at once (SmithyCore.js pathHeld). A repository's own old path is the framework's GitRepositoryPathRedirect.

field.name: oldPath
field.description: Lower case

field.name: redirectKindEnumId
field.description: SmithyRedirectKind: SrkGroup, SrkAccount

field.name: groupId
field.description: The group that had the path

field.name: partyId
field.description: The account that had the handle

entity.description: A file of a release (design-smithy §13.3): one a pipeline uploaded for the release's tag (a run's artifact, copied so the run's retention does not remove it) or one a Maintainer attached, or a container image's name. The file is at contentLocation, read and written through ec.resource; the row names no blob.

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The release (a WorkEffort of type WetRelease)

field.name: name
field.description: The file's name, unique in its release

field.name: assetKindEnumId
field.description: SmithyAssetKind: SakFile, SakImage

field.name: contentLocation
field.description: Where the file is; empty for an image's name

field.name: imageName
field.description: A container image's name

field.name: pipelineRunId
field.description: The run that uploaded it, when one did

field.name: artifactId
field.description: The run's artifact it was copied from, when it was

entity.description: An old path of a site, of one of its own hosts or of a host it replaces (a site that moved here, its forum), and where it now leads (design-smithy §13.6). A page request that no app's mount and no Smithy name takes is looked up here before Not Found (SmithySiteServices.resolve#Redirect). The target is a path of the site or an https address of one of its hosts, never another site's.

field.name: oldHost
field.description: Lower case; empty: the site's own hosts

field.name: oldPath
field.description: The path as it was, starting with /, without a query

field.name: targetPath
field.description: A path of the site, or an absolute https address of one of its hosts

field.name: sourceEnumId
field.description: SmithyRedirectSource: SrsSite, SrsForum, SrsGithub, SrsManual

entity.description: An import of a GitHub repository's labels, milestones, issues and pull requests into a repository of a group (design-smithy §11 Import, §18.2, DG8; SmithyImport.js): a checkpointed run that a step at a time (SmithyImportServices.run#Import) moves through its stages, resumable, waiting on the API's rate limit, and safe to run again (SmithyImportMap). The token is kept encrypted for the run and dropped when it ends.

field.name: repositoryId
field.description: The hosted repository it fills

field.name: sourceEnumId
field.description: SmithyImportSource: SisGithub

field.name: sourceRepository
field.description: owner/name, as typed

field.name: tokenRemoteId
field.description: The SystemMessageRemote whose password is the token, encrypted; empty once the run ended

field.name: options
field.description: JSON: issues, pullRequests

field.name: statusId
field.description: Status type SmithyImport: the stage

field.name: cursorJson
field.description: Where to resume: the stage's phase and page, the source's facts

field.name: countsJson
field.description: By type: imported, source (seen at GitHub), failed

field.name: reportJson
field.description: What could not be carried: a list of sourceType, sourceId and errorText (at most 500), and notCarried counts

field.name: waitingUntil
field.description: The API's rate limit: no step runs before this

field.name: leaseUntil
field.description: A step is running until this; another step waits

field.name: startedByPartyId
field.description: Steps run as this account, which must still hold the right

entity.description: What an import made of a source item, one row an item of a repository: a run that meets an item with a row Done or Skipped makes nothing of it again. sourceType: user, label, milestone, issue, pull, comment, review, reviewComment, reaction; reactionsDue (an item whose reactions are still to read: sourceId issue:n or comment:id, the post as targetId, statusId empty until read).

field.name: sourceId
field.description: GitHub's id

field.name: statusId
field.description: Status type SmithyImportItem: SmmDone, SmmSkipped, SmmFailed

entity.description: A Maintainer's approval of an outside pipeline run of a merge request (design-smithy §10, DG5): the head it was given for, as its pusher brought it. With outsideRunApproval first, later runs of that head run without waiting; a new head waits again until its author has had a merge request merged here by another account (SmithyPipelines.js).

field.name: pusherUserId
field.description: The account of the first push that brought the head (moqui.resource.GitCommitPush), _NA_ when none is recorded

field.name: urlSetByUserId
field.description: The Smithy Maintainer who set the URL, or turned the webhook on last (SmithyGit.js storeWebhook); its deliveries stop once that account no longer holds the delete right (SmithyCore.js pauseLostWebhooks).
